newConfirmedIssues.title: SFTP cleanup request can be forwarded after workspace changes during token status lookup
newConfirmedIssues.entry: file_cleanup_execute/file_cleanup_settle -> ProjectGateway.call -> McpHost.scopedFileCall -> files.cleanup.status -> original SFTP action
newConfirmedIssues.trigger: With a human-confirmed cleanup token, while status RPC is pending: (1) workspace changes A to B; (2) same Worker ID changes configured host; or (3) the project sync grant is revoked.
newConfirmedIssues.expected: Detect changed project and stop before the execution RPC; preserve old request and confirmation.
newConfirmedIssues.actual: Each fake status returns matching original node, after which files.cleanup.execute is forwarded despite the changed workspace, changed Worker target, or revoked grant; fake success is returned.
newConfirmedIssues.rootCause: src/extension/McpHost.ts scopedFileCall captures root before awaiting files.cleanup.status and does not recheck root or invocation authorization after the await; ProjectGateway pre-invocation checks happen earlier.
newConfirmedIssues.evidence: 2026-11-21 in-memory actual dist McpHost and ProjectGateway; VS Code, SFTP and grants replaced with software stubs, 48-character token and two-confirmation status; fake call sequence status(A), execute(A) after switching to B, exit 0. First fixture attempt failed exit 1 because SftpCleanupReview import required vscode; fixed fixture dependency and reran. No real SFTP or deletion. A second controlled Worker-config-switch test forwarded old host after the status wait, exit 0. Both use valid-shaped token and fake SFTP. A third controlled variant revoked the sync grant while the status request was suspended; the fake execute still received a call, exit 0. The same revoked-grant fixture also forwarded files.cleanup.settle, exit 0; same cause, not a second defect.
newConfirmedIssues.boundary: Demonstrates forbidden forwarding at SimpleExperiment boundary, not that actual companion executed deletion; inspect other token actions/review under same root cause without duplicate counting.
newConfirmedIssues.acceptance: After status wait revalidate bound project, applicable Worker target and authorization before forwarding; switched-workspace and changed-Worker tests send no execute/settle/review RPC; unchanged project and original human confirmation state remain functional.

newConfirmedIssues.rootCause: src/extension/CacheCleanupPanel.ts:59-60 advances client review stages and displays deleting optimistically; host lines 366-378 rejects review and invalid confirmations without a corresponding state reset/acknowledgement.
newConfirmedIssues.evidence: 2026-11-21 actual current TypeScript transpiled in-memory, real page script executed in a fake DOM against real host handler, worker/client and retention data mocked. Generation changed after successful scan; host error observed, two clicks produced deleting text, no delete-cache-candidates call; exit 0.
newConfirmedIssues.boundary: No real UI, SFTP, Worker or deletion; no claim that files were deleted.
newConfirmedIssues.acceptance: Rejected review or confirmation returns the page to a usable state with a truthful error, and deleting feedback appears only after the host has accepted that phase; preserve two independent full-path confirmations.

newConfirmedIssues.title: Project switch during experiment query can mix new-project operation rows into old-project response
newConfirmedIssues.entry: experiment_list -> ProjectGateway.call mcp.query -> ProjectQueries -> experimentList -> loadRemoteExperiments -> tasks.list then operations.list

newConfirmedIssues.title: Project bootstrap may schedule its background operation in a different workspace after async previews

newConfirmedIssues.trigger: Authorized bootstrap request begins in A; current workspace switches to B while one of its preliminary asynchronous preview/validation operations is pending.

newConfirmedIssues.rootCause: src/extension/legacy.ts:4089-4134 performs Promise.all then schedules without root or generation guard. Background method:4137-4174 also does not preserve originating context across prepare, validation and flow updates; Gateway only checks before invoking the method.
newConfirmedIssues.evidence: 2026-11-21 current source apiProjectBootstrap extracted/transpiled; fake preview resolves, fake validation changes workspace A->B, fake operation storage and background consumer record B, actual method returns started; exit 0. Fake consumer never executes prepare, sync or task.

newConfirmedIssues.acceptance: Bind bootstrap to originating workspace/generation, reject before background scheduling on changed context, and retain that binding across background prepare/validate/flow writes and terminal receipt; keep normal confirmation and failure status.

No runtime file read or Agent/SFTP/SSH action.；2026-11-21 实际编译ProjectGateway + 当前apiAgentLifecycle内存转译，假授权存储、固定同一项目/Worker、假runtime读取和假生命周期消费者：等待期间撤销agents授权后仍发假ensure、返回ok，exit0。没有实际读取runtime或调用Agent/SSH。

newConfirmedIssues.acceptance: After each async migration/runtime boundary, recheck bound project and configured exact Worker targets; revalidate agents grant before mutating lifecycle call; retain explicit migration digest and normal inspect behavior. 同项目授权撤销或Worker配置变更后不得调用生命周期消费者；原授权和目标不变时保留正常行为。

newConfirmedIssues.entry: 正常结果摘要 -> updateRegistry -> buildTables / FreshResults结果汇总；metric_leaderboard -> parseMetricsFile；metric_show / result_compare -> numericMetrics；latestResultCatalog表头词条；metric_list -> numericMetrics

newConfirmedIssues.boundary: 证明本轮写失败未反馈，不声称实际工作区发生EACCES、状态永久丢失或后续不会重试；队列保留dirty，重载后的实际状态取决于此前持久化结果。 只证实当次失败无反馈，不声称后续重试一定失败或真实记录被修改。

newConfirmedIssues.trigger: 当前项目草稿目录本轮stat因EACCES等I/O错误失败。
newConfirmedIssues.expected: 只有目录不存在时显示未启用；读取失败应保留错误及未核实状态，不把旧列表当作已确认空。
newConfirmedIssues.actual: stat所有异常变为false，draftPlanState覆盖为enabled=false、空drafts和cleanupCandidates且error为空；草稿及候选API随之返回空结果。
newConfirmedIssues.rootCause: src/extension/legacy.ts:19857-19859把目录stat所有异常catch为false并按缺失目录处理；drafts.list及drafts.cleanupCandidates共享refreshDraftPlans。
newConfirmedIssues.evidence: 2026-11-21 实际refreshDraftPlans内存转译，假正常目录及非空reconcile/candidate返回1草稿1候选；再使假stat抛EACCES，实际状态变disabled、两项为空、error空，断言exit0；API包装按当前源码核对。无真实目录、草稿、候选清理或持久化。
newConfirmedIssues.boundary: 模拟可达的stat错误，不声称真实目录不存在或文件丢失；reconcileDraftPlans及listCleanupCandidates均为假服务，未因此证明真实候选扫描行为。
newConfirmedIssues.acceptance: 明确区分ENOENT与其他stat错误并向调用方保留原因；不把读取失败当空目录，正常空目录及非空草稿读取保持现有契约。

originalClaim.title: 结果catalog静默截断拆表词条及产物目录
originalClaim.entry: 结果目录catalog -> renderProjectResultTables -> 拆表词条选择；结果产物列表 -> resultCatalog collect
originalClaim.trigger: 所选结果表某列含201个或更多不同词条，用户打开或搜索拆表词条。；或某产物目录有201个可列出的文件。
originalClaim.expected: 可选择全部实际词条，或明确显示候选不完整并提供继续查找方法；既有每次最多100个输出的限制另行保留。
originalClaim.actual: catalog只提供前200个不同值，没有该列截断标志；面板仅呈现和搜索这份列表，后续值无法从此入口选择，也没有不完整提示。 产物收集器也仅遍历目录的前200项，且先截断再过滤文件，后续有效产物不进入列表；全局遗漏计数不能反映此前的目录截断。
originalClaim.rootCause: src/results/ProjectResultTables.ts:592-594 对每列不同值直接slice(0,200)；src/ui/PanelHtml.legacy.ts:16834-16839及16891-16898仅使用catalog的values渲染搜索与选项。 同文件:603-605对readdir结果先slice(0,200)，最终omittedCounts按已收集数计算。
originalClaim.evidence: 2026-11-21 实际编译readCsv及当前catalog赋值语句内存执行：201条不同case中仅暴露前200，最后一项缺失，exit0；页面消费者为源码核对。未创建文件、计时或进行性能测试。 另提取真实collect源码，201个假目录项均为有效CSV时只返回200个产物，exit0；所有文件系统调用为内存替身。
originalClaim.boundary: 不声称真实项目达到该规模，不将此值上限与每次拆表100个词条的单次操作限制混同；外部实际目录未读取。 此项按结果catalog静默截断的同类缺陷合并记录，词条及目录各有独立位置和消费者。
originalClaim.acceptance: 全部有效值可分批选择或可明确继续查找，搜索能找到后续词条；选择与源行一致，保留当前每次输出上限及正常小表行为。 产物目录可完整查看或明确未完成及续查，按有效项统计并正确报告遗漏。

withdrawnFindings.correction: 先前两项200截断实测属于ProjectResultTables.resultCatalog旧目录扫描，当前readProjectResultCatalog与readProjectResultTableCatalog均使用LatestResultExport.latestResultCatalog；未找到旧扫描在src中的当前调用者。2026-11-21 当前latestResultCatalog源码内存转译、fake导出含201个词条，全部返回201，exit0；故撤回当前面板缺陷及其计数，原受控实验不删除。旧resultCatalog仅见自身tableCatalog及测试引用，未断言所有外部消费者均不存在。

originalClaim.title: 最佳指标汇总忽略越小越好方向

originalClaim.expected: 最佳汇总值为0.2，且最佳记录身份与该数值一致；越大越好仍取最大值。
originalClaim.actual: 最佳记录身份正确为loss=0.2的记录，但同一行values.loss.best错误为0.8。
originalClaim.rootCause: src/features/Results.legacy.ts:588将数值和聚合模式传给aggregate，未传metric.higherIsBetter；1295-1300的best无条件返回最大值。最佳记录选择单独使用方向，造成自相矛盾。
originalClaim.evidence: 2026-11-21 实际Results.legacy.ts内存转译，合成0.2和0.8记录及公开LeaderboardConfig，实得bestResultId=low、values.loss.best=0.8，exit0。ResultsFactory.leaderboard委托关系及高级排行榜基础调用按源码对照；未声称UI或真实结果触发。

originalClaim.title: 中位数与四分位汇总错误
originalClaim.trigger: 合法数值指标有偶数个样本，例如0.2与0.8，调用公开median_iqr聚合。
originalClaim.expected: 按项目已有分位数实现计算中位数和四分位数；该例中位数0.5，并保留四分位区间。
originalClaim.actual: 基础排行榜返回median=0.8且未返回四分位区间；同文件既有aggregateMetricValues对同样输入返回median=0.5及四分位数0.35/0.65。

originalClaim.evidence: 2026-11-21 当前Results.legacy.ts真实编译函数与现有aggregateMetricValues对照，纯内存两条记录0.2/0.8分别得到0.8与0.5及四分位区间，exit0；ResultsFactory委托依源码核对，无真实结果文件。

originalClaim.acceptance: 中位数和四分位数遵循既有分位数计算契约；覆盖偶数、奇数和单值，保留有效0与缺失值边界。

originalClaim.title: 排行榜中位数及缺失值排序错误
originalClaim.trigger: aggregate=median_iqr、primarySortMetric=loss、higherIsBetter=false；不同组中位数0.9和0.1按该顺序输入。；另一场景aggregate=best、越小越好，某组缺失loss。
originalClaim.expected: 按loss越小越好，0.1组应排在0.9组前。
originalClaim.actual: 结果仍为0.9组在前、0.1组在后，沿用输入顺序而未按中位数排序。 best模式下缺loss组反而排在有loss=0.1组之前。
originalClaim.rootCause: src/features/Results.legacy.ts:1311-1312的sortLeaderboard只读取mean或best，不读取median；两个缺省值相减为NaN，比较器不产生有效顺序。 此外缺值无条件回退-Infinity，在越小越好时被当作最小值排前。
originalClaim.evidence: 2026-11-21 实际buildResultLeaderboard内存转译，每组一条合成记录，中位数分别0.9与0.1，返回0.9组先于0.1，exit0。每组单样本避免U04-34偶数中位数缺陷干扰；无真实结果或文件。 另用实际函数、一个无loss组及一个loss=0.1组，best且越小越好时缺失组排第一，exit0；无真实文件。
originalClaim.boundary: 仅证实公开中位数配置的排序；不同于U04-34中位数数值及四分位计算缺陷，未声称当前默认CLI导出使用该聚合。
originalClaim.acceptance: 中位数聚合按指定指标与方向排序，缺值顺序明确；维持mean/best原有行为。 缺失组不得冒充最优值。

logicalActionCensus.scope: 同一当前源码逻辑入口母集：面板动作及语义payload、非命令按钮、辅助页及动态动作，再合并相同宿主动作的VSCode注册；MCP工具与CLI作为非按钮路由单列，不加到按钮逻辑分母。 该母集包括条件保存与legacy激活回退入口，不等于默认窗口此刻显示的集合。
logicalActionCensus.method: 按页面+实际动作+有意义payload归一；重复数据行/模板不按实例计；明确同宿主且同参数的命令归并，条件保存项保留；无生产链的旧trace/产物模板及字符串假命中排除。已结论为已有受限证据或确认问题，并非全面通过。 unreviewed表示尚未分类，实际未完成数须含延期；所有concluded_scoped均为引用处限定证据。
